book.genre.help: A plain-word genre. Other, or text in the brief, is your own.
book.tone.help: A plain-word tone. Other, or text in the brief, is your own.
book.length.long_note: Very long books are written as short scenes — quality is still being checked.
setting.book.pages.help: From 1 to 2,000 pages. The length chips write 25, 80, 250, or 550.
setting.book.words.help: Words on one page. The length preset writes 250.
setting.book.scenes.help: A minimum. The planner adds scenes when one scene would not fit a draft.
setting.book.chapters.help: Zero follows the planner. Any other number, up to 400, is kept.
setting.book.prompt.help: The compiled brief. A hand edit replaces that prompt.
setting.book.tier.help: Standard is one model. Least censored is the low-refusal pass.
setting.book.vram.help: Auto follows the card. 24 GB stays off when the card cannot run it.
setting.book.abliterated.help: A separate download. The book still runs on the stock model until it is installed.
setting.book.model.help: The model id the registry resolves for this tier.
setting.book.readers.help: Who the book is for. This does not filter the text.
setting.book.mode.help: Where the book waits for approval.
setting.book.dark.help: Off uses one model. On drafts, then fills dark scenes with the second model.
setting.book.export.help: An extra file beside the EPUB.
setting.book.sound.help: Write sound markup for Audiobook Builder.
